title: Update address in Aadhaar
content:
Update address in Aadhaar
# Aadhaar address update

title: Update address in Aadhaar
content:
Update address in Aadhaar
## Online
1. Log in on myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in with your Aadhaar number and mobile OTP.
2. Choose address update and upload a valid address proof (rent agreement, electricity bill,
   bank passbook).
3. Note the URN and track the status online.

title: Update address in Aadhaar
content:
Update address in Aadhaar
## At an Aadhaar centre
Visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra or enrolment centre with the original address proof. A fee
applies at the centre (₹50 at the time of writing; check the current fee).

title: Update address in Aadhaar
content:
Update address in Aadhaar
## Time
Usually updated within a few days to 30 days.

title: Ayushman card (PM-JAY)
content:
Ayushman card (PM-JAY)
# Ayushman card

title: Ayushman card (PM-JAY)
content:
Ayushman card (PM-JAY)
## Check if you are eligible
Check with your Aadhaar or ration card on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or at a Jan Seva Kendra /
empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk.

title: Ayushman card (PM-JAY)
content:
Ayushman card (PM-JAY)
## Make the card
1. Log in with mobile OTP, verify with Aadhaar (OTP or fingerprint).
2. Download the card. Show it at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.

title: Ayushman card (PM-JAY)
content:
Ayushman card (PM-JAY)
## Fees
Making the card is free.

title: Birth certificate (Lucknow)
content:
Birth certificate (Lucknow)
# Birth certificate

title: Birth certificate (Lucknow)
content:
Birth certificate (Lucknow)
## Who registers
Births in a hospital are usually reported by the hospital. For home births, a parent or
family member registers the birth. Registration within 21 days of birth is free under the
Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969.

title: Birth certificate (Lucknow)
content:
Birth certificate (Lucknow)
## Steps
1. If the baby was born in a hospital, ask the hospital whether it has registered the birth.
2. Otherwise register online on the Civil Registration System portal (crsorgi.gov.in) or at
   the Nagar Nigam zonal office birth and death registration counter.
3. Fill in the child's details, parents' names and address, and upload the documents.
4. After verification, download the certificate from the portal or collect it from the office.

title: Birth certificate (Lucknow)
content:
Birth certificate (Lucknow)
## Documents
- Hospital discharge slip or birth report (for hospital births)
- Parents' ID proof (Aadhaar or voter ID) and address proof
- An affidavit for home births or late registration

title: Birth certificate (Lucknow)
content:
Birth certificate (Lucknow)
## Fees and time
Free if registered within 21 days. A small late fee applies after 21 days. After one year the
birth can only be registered with an order from the SDM / magistrate. The certificate is
usually ready within 7 working days of verification. Check the current late fee at the office.

title: Building map approval and construction notices — LDA
content:
Building map approval and construction notices — LDA
# Building map approval

title: Building map approval and construction notices — LDA
content:
Building map approval and construction notices — LDA
## Steps
1. Get the building plan drawn by a registered architect.
2. Apply through LDA's online building permission system with the ownership documents.
3. Pay the fees shown after scrutiny. Start construction only after approval.

title: Building map approval and construction notices — LDA
content:
Building map approval and construction notices — LDA
## If you get a notice for unauthorised construction
Read the date by which you must reply. Reply in writing before that date with your approved
map (if any) and ownership papers. You can apply for compounding (regularisation) of eligible
deviations. If sealing or demolition is ordered, you can appeal within the time written on the
order. Consult a lawyer for demolition notices.

title: Caste certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Caste certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
# Caste certificate

title: Caste certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Caste certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
## Steps
1. Apply on e-District UP (edistrict.up.gov.in) or at a Jan Seva Kendra.
2. Choose SC, ST or OBC and fill in family details.
3. The Lekhpal and Revenue Inspector verify, then the Tehsildar approves.
4. Download the certificate with your application number.

title: Caste certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Caste certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
## Documents
- Aadhaar card and a photo
- A family member's caste certificate, if available
- Self-declaration and address proof

title: Caste certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Caste certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
## Fees and time
A small service fee at the Jan Seva Kendra. Usually 7 to 15 working days, longer if field
verification is needed.

title: File a public grievance — IGRS / Jansunwai (UP)
content:
File a public grievance — IGRS / Jansunwai (UP)
# Public grievance (Jansunwai)

title: File a public grievance — IGRS / Jansunwai (UP)
content:
File a public grievance — IGRS / Jansunwai (UP)
## Steps
1. File online on jansunwai.up.nic.in or call the CM helpline 1076.
2. Choose the department and describe the problem with the location.
3. Note the complaint number and track its status online.

title: File a public grievance — IGRS / Jansunwai (UP)
content:
File a public grievance — IGRS / Jansunwai (UP)
## For civic problems in Lucknow
Garbage, drains, roads and streetlights can also be reported to Lucknow Nagar Nigam on 1533,
or through JANSEVA's report feature, which routes it to the right department.

title: Death certificate (Lucknow)
content:
Death certificate (Lucknow)
# Death certificate

title: Death certificate (Lucknow)
content:
Death certificate (Lucknow)
## Steps
1. Deaths in a hospital are reported by the hospital; ask them for the registration.
2. For deaths at home, a family member registers on crsorgi.gov.in or at the Nagar Nigam zonal
   office within 21 days.
3. Collect or download the certificate after verification.

title: Death certificate (Lucknow)
content:
Death certificate (Lucknow)
## Documents
- Hospital death summary, or a certificate from the cremation / burial ground
- ID proof of the deceased and of the applicant
- Affidavit if registering late

title: Death certificate (Lucknow)
content:
Death certificate (Lucknow)
## Fees and time
Free within 21 days; a late fee applies after that, and after one year an SDM / magistrate
order is needed. Usually ready in about 7 working days. A death certificate is needed for
widow pension, property transfer and insurance claims.

title: Domicile (residence) certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Domicile (residence) certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
# Domicile certificate

title: Domicile (residence) certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Domicile (residence) certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
## Steps
1. Apply on e-District UP (edistrict.up.gov.in) or at a Jan Seva Kendra.
2. Fill in how long you have lived at the address and upload proof.
3. The Lekhpal verifies and the Tehsildar approves.

title: Domicile (residence) certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Domicile (residence) certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
## Documents
- Aadhaar card
- Address proof such as an electricity bill, property tax receipt or rent agreement
- Self-declaration and a photo

title: Domicile (residence) certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Domicile (residence) certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
## Fees and time
A small service fee at the Jan Seva Kendra; usually 7 to 15 working days.

title: New electricity connection and bills — UPPCL (Lucknow)
content:
New electricity connection and bills — UPPCL (Lucknow)
# Electricity connection and bills

title: New electricity connection and bills — UPPCL (Lucknow)
content:
New electricity connection and bills — UPPCL (Lucknow)
## New connection
1. Apply online through the UPPCL consumer portal (Jhatpat connection) or at the sub-division
   office.
2. Upload ID proof, ownership or tenancy proof, and a photo.
3. Pay the estimate shown after the site survey. The meter is installed after payment.

title: New electricity connection and bills — UPPCL (Lucknow)
content:
New electricity connection and bills — UPPCL (Lucknow)
## Paying a bill
Pay on the UPPCL website or app, at a Jan Seva Kendra, or at the sub-division office.

title: New electricity connection and bills — UPPCL (Lucknow)
content:
New electricity connection and bills — UPPCL (Lucknow)
## Wrong bill or no power
Call the UPPCL helpline 1912. For a wrong reading, complain before paying and keep the
complaint number.

title: Income certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Income certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
# Income certificate

title: Income certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Income certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
## Steps
1. Apply online on e-District UP (edistrict.up.gov.in) or at any Jan Seva Kendra (CSC).
2. Enter family income from all sources and upload the documents.
3. The Lekhpal verifies, and the Tehsildar approves the application.
4. Download the certificate using your application number.

title: Income certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Income certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
## Documents
- Aadhaar card
- Self-declaration of income (form available on the portal)
- Ration card or address proof, and a passport-size photo
- Salary slip or other income proof if you have one

title: Income certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Income certificate (Uttar Pradesh)
## Fees and time
A small service fee is charged at a Jan Seva Kendra (check the current rate at the
centre). Usually issued in 7 to 15 working days. Needed for scholarships, pensions and many
welfare schemes.

title: Marriage registration (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Marriage registration (Uttar Pradesh)
# Marriage registration

title: Marriage registration (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Marriage registration (Uttar Pradesh)
## Steps
1. Apply online on the IGRS UP portal (igrsup.gov.in) under marriage registration.
2. Fill in details of both spouses and two witnesses and upload the documents.
3. Book a date and visit the sub-registrar office with both spouses and witnesses.
4. The certificate is issued after verification.

title: Marriage registration (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Marriage registration (Uttar Pradesh)
## Documents
- Age proof and Aadhaar of both spouses
- Marriage invitation card or photo of the marriage
- ID of two witnesses, and address proof

title: Marriage registration (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Marriage registration (Uttar Pradesh)
## Fees
A registration fee is paid online; check the current fee on the portal.

title: Old age pension (Vridhavastha Pension), Uttar Pradesh
content:
Old age pension (Vridhavastha Pension), Uttar Pradesh
# Old age pension

title: Old age pension (Vridhavastha Pension), Uttar Pradesh
content:
Old age pension (Vridhavastha Pension), Uttar Pradesh
## Who can apply
Residents of UP aged 60 or above whose family income is below the limit set by the
department (see the scheme finder for the current limit).

title: Old age pension (Vridhavastha Pension), Uttar Pradesh
content:
Old age pension (Vridhavastha Pension), Uttar Pradesh
## Steps
1. Apply online on the SSPY portal (sspy-up.gov.in) or at a Jan Seva Kendra.
2. Upload the documents and submit. Note the registration number.
3. After verification, the pension is paid into your bank account every quarter.

title: Old age pension (Vridhavastha Pension), Uttar Pradesh
content:
Old age pension (Vridhavastha Pension), Uttar Pradesh
## Documents
- Aadhaar card, age proof
- Income certificate
- Bank passbook (account linked to Aadhaar) and a photo

title: Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
# Property tax (gṛhakar) in Lucknow

title: Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
## What the demand notice means
Lucknow Nagar Nigam sends a yearly demand notice for property (house) tax, often together with
water tax (jalkar) and sewer charges. It shows your property ID (bhavan sankhya), the financial
year, the amount due and the last date. Paying late adds a surcharge, and long-pending dues can
lead to recovery proceedings.

title: Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
## How to pay online
1. Open the Lucknow Nagar Nigam portal (lmc.up.nic.in) and go to property tax payment.
2. Search with your property ID / house number from the notice.
3. Check the owner name and amount, then pay by UPI, card or net banking.
4. Download and keep the receipt.

title: Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
## How to pay offline
Pay at your zonal office tax counter with the notice. Ask for a printed receipt.

title: Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
## If the amount looks wrong
File an objection (aapatti) at the zonal office before the last date, with the notice, your
previous receipts and property documents. Keep a stamped copy of your objection.

title: Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Pay property (house) tax — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
## Helpline
Lucknow Nagar Nigam call centre: 1533 (check current timings).

title: Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
# Ration card

title: Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
## Types
- Antyodaya (AAY) for the poorest families
- Priority Household (Paatra Grihasthi) for eligible low-income families

title: Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
## Steps
1. Apply online on the Food and Civil Supplies portal (fcs.up.gov.in) or at a Jan Seva Kendra.
2. Add every family member with their Aadhaar number.
3. The supply inspector verifies eligibility.
4. After approval, collect ration from your allotted fair price shop.

title: Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
## Documents
- Aadhaar of every family member
- Income certificate, address proof, bank passbook and a photo of the head of family (usually
  the eldest woman)

title: Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
content:
Ration card (Uttar Pradesh)
## Fees and time
There is no fee to apply on the portal. Verification usually takes about 30 days.

title: Trade / shop licence — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Trade / shop licence — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
# Trade licence

title: Trade / shop licence — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Trade / shop licence — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
## Steps
1. Apply at the Nagar Nigam licence section or through the Nagar Nigam portal.
2. Give the business type, address and owner details.
3. Pay the licence fee, which depends on the trade and area.
4. Renew it every year before it expires.

title: Trade / shop licence — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Trade / shop licence — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
## Documents
- Aadhaar and photo of the owner
- Proof of the shop premises (rent agreement or ownership) and a property tax receipt

title: Trade / shop licence — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
content:
Trade / shop licence — Lucknow Nagar Nigam
## Street vendors
Street vendors are registered by the Town Vending Committee under the Street Vendors Act,
2014. Ask your zonal office about vending certificates. See also the PM SVANidhi loan scheme.

title: Pay or contest a traffic e-challan
content:
Pay or contest a traffic e-challan
# Traffic e-challan

title: Pay or contest a traffic e-challan
content:
Pay or contest a traffic e-challan
## Check and pay
1. Open echallan.parivahan.gov.in and search by challan number, vehicle number or DL number.
2. Check the photo and offence details, then pay online.
3. Download the receipt.

title: Pay or contest a traffic e-challan
content:
Pay or contest a traffic e-challan
## If you think it is wrong
Do not pay; choose to contest it. Unpaid challans are sent to the virtual court, where you can
respond online.

title: New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
content:
New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
# New water connection

title: New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
content:
New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
## Steps
1. Apply at the Jal Kal Vibhag zonal office or through the Nagar Nigam portal.
2. Submit the form with property documents and a clear property tax receipt.
3. A Jal Kal engineer inspects the site and tells you the connection charges.
4. Pay the charges; the connection is installed after payment.

title: New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
content:
New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
## Documents
- Ownership proof (sale deed / registry) or the owner's consent if you are a tenant
- Latest property tax (gṛhakar) receipt with no dues
- Aadhaar card and a photo

title: New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
content:
New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
## Fees and time
Charges depend on pipe size and road-cutting. The engineer's estimate tells you the exact
amount. Usually 15 to 30 days.

title: New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
content:
New water connection — Jal Kal Vibhag Lucknow
## Water bill problems
For wrong bills or no supply, contact the Jal Kal zonal office or the Nagar Nigam call
centre 1533.

title: Widow pension (Nirashrit Mahila Pension), Uttar Pradesh
content:
Widow pension (Nirashrit Mahila Pension), Uttar Pradesh
# Widow pension

title: Widow pension (Nirashrit Mahila Pension), Uttar Pradesh
content:
Widow pension (Nirashrit Mahila Pension), Uttar Pradesh
## Who can apply
Widowed women aged 18 or above living in UP whose family income is below the scheme limit.

title: Widow pension (Nirashrit Mahila Pension), Uttar Pradesh
content:
Widow pension (Nirashrit Mahila Pension), Uttar Pradesh
## Steps
1. Apply online on the SSPY portal (sspy-up.gov.in) or at a Jan Seva Kendra.
2. Upload the husband's death certificate and other documents.
3. After verification by the district office, the pension is paid into your bank account.

title: Widow pension (Nirashrit Mahila Pension), Uttar Pradesh
content:
Widow pension (Nirashrit Mahila Pension), Uttar Pradesh
## Documents
- Husband's death certificate
- Aadhaar card, income certificate, address proof
- Bank passbook and a photo
